name: Macy Industries
old_description: In business since 1975, Macy is made up of a hardworking team of knowledgeable metal fabrication experts with quality and integrity in mind. From our family to yours, we appreciate your support and look forward to accommodating your metal fabrication needs.
about:
Macy Industries operates from Hooksett, New Hampshire, where it has been providing custom metal fabrication since 1975. The company is family-owned and describes itself as a family-run business, built on a multi-generational commitment to quality and integrity in metalwork.

The shop delivers design, fabrication, installation, and maintenance services across a range of metal products. Its capabilities span custom dust and fume collection systems, industrial ventilation, stainless steel tanks, medical laboratory and commercial kitchen countertops, mezzanines, handrails, exhaust hoods, grease ducts, stairs, railings, exhaust stacks, power-lift doors, and spiral ductwork. The team works with stainless steel, aluminum, galvanized metal, copper, and carbon fiber, producing everything from architectural features such as copper hoods and retractable roofs to structural frames, machine guarding, and platforms.

Customers come from commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Construction managers, general contractors, builders, and architects rely on Macy for metal staircases, railings, balconies, awnings, and hydraulic doors. Facility managers and industrial engineers specify its dust, fume, and mist collection systems, while homeowners and residential architects commission copper gutters, countertops, and custom railings. The company also serves architectural millwork shops, plumbing and HVAC contractors, and restaurant and hotel projects.

Macy emphasizes a collaborative process that integrates engineering design, production, and installation under one roof, a model it says keeps clients returning with new projects. The firm highlights its engineering talent and flexibility to produce difficult-to-replicate products as its competitive advantage.

name: Maddox Industrial Transformer
old_description: I have been very happy with the three 15kva transformers we purchased from Maddox. The team is ready to please, friendly and actually helpful. The cost vs quality is unfounded. Shipping for these larger units was surprisingly fast too. We will definitely be doing business with them in the future!
about:
Maddox Industrial Transformer is headquartered in Battle Ground, Washington, with additional facilities in Greer and Simpsonville, South Carolina; Fountain Inn, South Carolina; Batavia, Ohio; Moscow, Idaho; Houston, Texas; and Woodruff, South Carolina. The company was founded in 2015 by Camden Spiller and a team of transformer industry veterans whose experience dates back to the 1980s. It remains privately owned and has grown to employ more than 400 people across its seven U.S. locations.

The company designs, manufactures, and warrants padmount, substation, polemount, and dry-type transformers ranging from 3 kVA to 160,000 kVA, along with pad-mounted and metal-enclosed switchgear up to 35 kV. It also operates a national service network providing transformer repair, rewinding, and maintenance; a rental fleet of low- and medium-voltage units; a surplus purchasing program; and a parts inventory covering fluid, bushings, fuses, and gauges. Maddox reports having shipped over 100,000 transformers and maintains thousands of units in stock for same-day dispatch.

Customers span data centers, manufacturers, renewable energy developers, electrical distributors, bitcoin mining operations, electrical contractors, and real estate developers. The firm emphasizes commercial and industrial projects rather than utility accounts, citing clients such as a lumber mill, an irrigation district, a data center operator, and an electric bus fleet.

Maddox positions itself on speed and purchasing simplicity—offering quotes within 30 minutes, same-day shipping on stock units, and expedited production slots for custom builds—while still meeting ANSI, NEMA, DOE, and IEEE standards. Leadership says the company was started to give commercial and industrial buyers the lead times and responsiveness typically reserved for utility customers.

name: Magic Solar
old_description: Transform your business, farm or home with the limitless power of solar energy. Magic Solar is Idaho's trusted partner for reliable solar installations built to fit every project. Whether you're a business aiming for environmental responsibility or a homeowner seeking energy independence, our solar energy systems are designed and built to support your needs. We know every solar panel we install contributes to a brighter, greener tomorrow for Boise, Twin Falls, and beyond.
about:
Magic Solar operates from Boise, Idaho, serving the Treasure Valley and Magic Valley regions including Twin Falls. The company provides solar installation services for commercial, residential, and agricultural customers. While the firm’s exact founding date is not publicly disclosed, its team brings over 40 years of combined industry experience.

The company designs and installs photovoltaic systems through a six-step process: free on-site estimation, design approval, permitting, installation, inspection, and system setup with owner training. Magic Solar handles all paperwork and coordinates with utilities, offering both rooftop and ground-mount arrays for businesses, farms, and homes. The firm also assists customers with financing options and federal and state incentive programs such as the Investment Tax Credit and USDA REAP grants.

Magic Solar’s customer base spans commercial facilities seeking to reduce overhead, agricultural operations pursuing energy independence, and homeowners across the Treasure and Magic Valleys. The company emphasizes local knowledge, tailoring designs to Idaho’s climate and utility structures.

The company cites its six core values — Attitude, Integrity, Character, Vision, Determination, and Safety — as the foundation of its service model. Ongoing crew training through OSHA and AGC programs, weekly safety reviews, and community partnerships with organizations like the Boys & Girls Club and the Jae Foundation are presented as key differentiators.

name: Maine Mold & Machine
old_description: Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. specializes in plastic injection molding. With our molding capabilities, we can do the modification and repair of the molds, part assembly as well as plastic part production - all under one roof.
about:
Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. operates from Hartford, Maine, where it was founded in 1985. The company has served the New England region for decades, providing plastic injection molding services from its facility on Town Farm Road.

The shop specializes in plastic injection molding and offers mold modification and repair, part assembly, and full plastic part production under one roof. It processes a wide range of materials, from basic plastics to highly engineered resins, and handles orders from short-run sampling to long-term, high-volume production runs.

Its customer base spans industrial filtration systems, military components, medical devices, fishing industry equipment, home gaming products, and other specialty sectors. The company primarily serves clients across Maine, Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island.

Maine Mold & Machine emphasizes its integrated approach—combining mold maintenance, assembly, and production in a single facility—as a way to streamline lead times and quality control for customers with diverse volume requirements.

about:
Maine Woods Company operates from Portage, Maine, where it has been producing hardwood lumber since 1841. The company runs a state-of-the-art sawmill and dry line in the northern Maine woods, leveraging the region's colder climate to yield hard maple, yellow birch, soft maple, and white ash with distinctive color and grain. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in public materials.

The facility specializes in precision manufacturing of hardwood lumber, offering rough dimension stock, surfaced lumber, and specialty products such as bird's eye and flame birch. Maine Woods Company identifies itself as the largest single manufacturer of hard maple lumber in the Northeast, with all output carrying Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certification. The sawmill and dry line are described as state-of-the-art, though specific equipment models and facility size are not published.

The company serves discriminating buyers of northern hardwoods, including manufacturers of furniture, flooring, cabinetry, and other wood products that require consistent color and grain quality. Its lumber is sold through a stock list that includes the four primary species and specialty figured woods. The firm was featured in the December 2022 issue of National Hardwood Magazine, highlighting its market presence.

Maine Woods Company's stated mission is "Running right, running safe to sustainably produce the highest quality hardwood lumber." The firm emphasizes its sustainable forestry practices, the natural advantages of Maine's climate, and its investment in modern sawmill and drying technology as key differentiators.

The company focuses on quality service and building lasting relationships rather than simply processing orders.

The shop offers screen printing, embroidery, specialty decoration, graphic design, and custom webstore development. Clients range from corporate buyers needing branded polos, jackets, and hats to schools and sports teams ordering uniforms and spirit wear. The company also serves organizations that use custom webstores to streamline group purchasing for events and outings.

Mainstreet Iowa Apparel differentiates itself with quick turnarounds, competitive pricing, and a full-service experience that includes in-house graphic design, Pantone color matching for screen printing inks, custom thread color matching for embroidery, and dedicated webstore setup for recurring orders.

name: Majestic Metals by Fathom Manufacturing
old_description: Majestic Metals was founded in 1979. Across more than 45 years, the company has built an exceptional reputation for service, quality, and speed in sheet metal fabrication.
about:
Majestic Metals by Fathom Manufacturing operates a sheet metal fabrication facility in Denver, Colorado. The business was founded in 1979 as Majestic Metals and has accumulated more than 45 years of experience in precision fabrication. Today it operates as part of the Fathom Manufacturing network, maintaining the same end-to-end approach that defined its early years.

The Denver facility takes parts from cutting and forming through finishing and final assembly, delivering complete fabricated products rather than loose components. Core processes include laser cutting (fiber, solid-state, and CO2), CNC punching, press-brake forming up to 12 feet and 220 tons, welding (arc, MIG, TIG, spot, and laser), captive hardware installation, painting, powder coating, screen printing, mechanical and electro-mechanical assembly, and in-house CNC machining for post-mill features. The shop runs three fiber/solid-state lasers, two CO2 lasers, five punch presses, thirteen press brakes, twelve TIG welders, seven MIG welders, and one laser welder, with automated loading that enables lights-out production for runs of 100 to 10,000 pieces. Work spans prototype through full production across aluminum, steel, and stainless steel from 0.010 to 0.50 inch thick, holding ±0.005 inch on cutting and punching.

The facility serves data-center and IT infrastructure, EV charging equipment, medical device housings, self-service kiosks and retail technology, industrial equipment enclosures, military and defense, automotive, energy, agriculture, semiconductor, and consumer electronics and lighting. Customers include a major semiconductor manufacturer that cites accuracy, flatness, and consistency across runs.

The company emphasizes a single-source model that eliminates multi-vendor coordination, a value-engineering mindset applied from prototype to production, design-for-manufacturability support, and a 98% on-time delivery rate. ITAR registration allows it to handle government and defense projects.

name: Manchester Packaging Co
old_description: Founded in 1969, Manchester Packaging Company began business with the goal of providing our customers with quality economical packaging and we continue that tradition today.
about:
Manchester Packaging Company was founded in 1969 in St. James, Missouri. The company began with the goal of providing customers with quality economical packaging, a tradition it continues today. No founders are named in available records, and ownership structure is not publicly disclosed.

The company operates as a custom manufacturer of polyethylene blown film and bags. Its core processes include mono-layer and three-layer co-extrusion using prime resins, producing films with no-slip, medium-slip, high-slip, linear clarity, and biopolymer blends. Flexographic printing capability covers one to eight colors in line or process designs, with both surface and reverse printing on film and bags. Bag manufacturing includes printed and unprinted side-seal and bottom-seal configurations made to custom sizes within equipment limits. The facility also offers U.S. Postal Service mail overwrap services.

Manchester Packaging serves manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and retail businesses across the packaging sector. Its film and bag products are used in shrink film, form-fill-seal applications, wicketed bags, perforated-on-roll bags, and draw-tape bags. The postal overwrap capability indicates a presence in the mailing and shipping supply chain.

The company emphasizes its FDA-approved polyethylene film and a waste-reduction practice that recycles and reprocesses 99 percent of production scrap. Its founding principle of delivering economical quality remains the stated differentiator.

name: Manufacture Alabama
old_description: is the only trade association in the state dedicated exclusively to the competitive, legislative, regulatory and operational interests and needs of manufacturers and their partner industries and businesses.
about:
Manufacture Alabama operates from Montgomery as the state's sole trade association focused exclusively on the legislative, regulatory, and operational concerns of manufacturers and their partner businesses. The organization represents hundreds of companies ranging from global corporations to small family-owned operations, each described as a vital component of Alabama's economy and job base. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The association provides a suite of services designed to support vibrant manufacturing operations, including environmental, safety, and human resources compliance assistance; government and regulatory representation; workforce development strategies; transportation and infrastructure initiatives; industry promotion; and tax, energy, and other policy support. A staff of five leads these efforts, headed by President & CEO Jon Barganier, alongside specialists in government affairs, workforce development, communications, and an affiliated executive director role.

Membership is divided into two categories: Manufacturing Members and Partner Members. The association serves manufacturers across all sectors in Alabama, as well as businesses that partner with the manufacturing ecosystem. Programs such as Girls Learning About Manufacturing (GLAM) aim to cultivate future talent by creating interest in manufacturing careers among female students entering the workforce.

Manufacture Alabama states its mission as creating a business and political climate that promotes a positive, competitive environment and enhances growth opportunities for Alabama manufacturers.
